description: This file contains functions for fetching and processing dashboard module data and overview metrics from a backend API, including URL resolution, JSON fetching, and data normalization.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with optional credentials, handling organization ID and error cases.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a dashboard overview, attempting multiple endpoints or deriving minimal data if endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total users and deployed applications for the overview screen.
